title: X-MuTeST: A Multilingual Benchmark for Explainable Hate Speech Detection and A Novel LLM-consulted Explanation Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and linguistic task of multilingual hate speech detection and the explainability of model rationales using LLMs. While hate speech is a social and ethical issue, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethical philosophies.
